subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers close or supersede the open conflicting fork PR before allowing a fresh current-main fix for this Debug Snapshots issue?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but an open fork PR still references this issue with closing syntax and is not mergeable, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current route-owned Debug page and view files.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current localized Debug page/view structure before review.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the existing fork PR, accepting that no new ClawSweeper fix should be queued meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current route-owned Debug page and view files.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current-main history on the route-owned Debug files that a fresh fix would touch.
